+++ b/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value) continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value) continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');

+const before = 'which is 2,048 pixels square';

+for (const base of [root, release]) {
+  for (const relative of ['editorial/output/seedream-5-pro-guide.md','src/pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.astro']) {
+    const file = path.join(base, relative);

+    if (!value.includes(before)) throw new Error('Missing expected sentence in '+file);

+    fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');

[Image] pass1 -> pass3 : « vrai pot » devient « pot réel » ; registre descriptif plus précis.
[Titre] pass1 -> pass2 : « pour les produits » devient « pour les images produit » ; sujet du guide explicite.
[Titre] pass3 : titre natif de pass2 conservé après relecture.
[Résumé] pass1 -> pass2 : la chaîne nominale est remplacée par des verbes pour vérifier le sens.
[Résumé] pass2 -> pass3 : « capacités documentées » précise l’attribution ; la 4K reste associée à la 4.5.
[Finition] Apostrophes courbes, espaces insécables et casse des modèles vérifiées.
[Préservation] Aucune autre traduction de common.json réécrite.

### fr: resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide

[Méthode] Trois passes successives : réécriture native, révision du français seul, puis finition éditoriale.

[Introduction] pass1 -> pass3 : « répond aux briefs » devient « répond mieux à un brief » ; rythme plus naturel, choix du master explicité.
[Méthode documentaire] pass1 -> pass3 : deux origines séparées en phrases lisibles, documentation puis quatre tests ; date conservée.
[Annonce du modèle] pass1 -> pass3 : « progrès de structure, de texte » devient « progrès dans […] la reproduction du texte » ; correction de la collocation.
[Attribution] Les promesses de ByteDance restent attribuées ; les limites reconnues et la mention « notre traduction » sont conservées.

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value) continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value) continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }

diff --git a/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs b/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..470870aec4c4d8a63dbfd627199c40bfef0014e3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value) continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const before = 'which is 2,048 pixels square';
+const after = 'enough for a 2,048-pixel square';
+for (const base of [root, release]) {
+  for (const relative of ['editorial/output/seedream-5-pro-guide.md','src/pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.astro']) {
+    const file = path.join(base, relative);
+    const value = fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+    if (!value.includes(before)) throw new Error('Missing expected sentence in '+file);
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,value.replace(before,after));
+  }
+  for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+    const file = path.join(base,'src/i18n/dict',locale,'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json');
+    const dict = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const result = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(dict).map(([k,v])=>[k.replace(before,after),v]));
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');
+  }
+}
+fs.copyFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/research/seedream-5-pro-guide.md'),path.join(release,'editorial/research/seedream-5-pro-guide.md'));
+const ids = ['common','resources/how-to','resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide','app/create','app/engines','resources/how-to/chatgpt-image-2-product-prompting-guide','resources/how-to/product-photo-to-lifestyle-image'];
+let log = '\n## Publication translation review: seedream-5-pro-guide\n\n';
+for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+  for (const id of ids) {
+    const source = path.join(__dirname,'passes',locale,id,'changes.md');
+    if (!fs.existsSync(source)) throw new Error('Missing pass summary '+source);
+    log += `\n### ${locale}: ${id}\n\n`+fs.readFileSync(source,'utf8')+'\n';
+  }
+}
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs/2026-10-21-publish.txt'),log);
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/2026-10-21.md'),log);
+console.log('Corrected the numerical relationship in draft/page and both dictionary keys; copied all 14 translation summaries into both run logs.');

diff --git a/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs b/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..470870aec4c4d8a63dbfd627199c40bfef0014e3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value) continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const before = 'which is 2,048 pixels square';
+const after = 'enough for a 2,048-pixel square';
+for (const base of [root, release]) {
+  for (const relative of ['editorial/output/seedream-5-pro-guide.md','src/pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.astro']) {
+    const file = path.join(base, relative);
+    const value = fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+    if (!value.includes(before)) throw new Error('Missing expected sentence in '+file);
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,value.replace(before,after));
+  }
+  for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+    const file = path.join(base,'src/i18n/dict',locale,'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json');
+    const dict = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const result = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(dict).map(([k,v])=>[k.replace(before,after),v]));
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');
+  }
+}

+for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+  for (const id of ids) {
+    const source = path.join(__dirname,'passes',locale,id,'changes.md');
+    if (!fs.existsSync(source)) throw new Error('Missing pass summary '+source);
+    log += `\n### ${locale}: ${id}\n\n`+fs.readFileSync(source,'utf8')+'\n';
+  }
+}
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs/2026-10-21-publish.txt'),log);
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/2026-10-21.md'),log);
+console.log('Corrected the numerical relationship in draft/page and both dictionary keys; copied all 14 translation summaries into both run logs.');

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const {parse} = require('node-html-parser');
+const base = path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-release','.vercel/output/static');
+const slug = 'seedream-5-pro-guide';
+const routes = [
+  ['en',`/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+  ['fr','/fr/ressources/guides-pratiques/seedream-5-pro-prompts-pour-images-produit'],
+  ['zh',`/zh/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+];
+const check = (condition,message) => {if (!condition) throw new Error(message);};
+for(const [locale,route] of routes){
+  const file=path.join(base,route,'index.html');
+  check(fs.existsSync(file),'Missing output '+file);
+  const source=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+  const html=parse(source);
+  const h1=html.querySelector('h1')?.textContent;
+  check(!!h1,'Missing heading '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.getAttribute('href')==='https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route,'Wrong canonical '+locale);
+  for(const lang of ['en','fr','zh-CN'])check(html.querySelector(`link[hreflang="${lang}"]`),'Missing alternate '+lang+' '+locale);
+  check(source.includes(`/Images/howto-${slug}.webp`),'Hero missing '+locale);
+  const shot='/Images/help/create-an-image-studio'+(locale==='en'?'':'.'+locale)+'.webp';
+  check(source.includes(shot),'Wrong capture '+locale);
+  check(!/\b(?:TODO|FIXME|TBD|TKTK)\b/.test(html.querySelector('main')?.textContent||''),'Unclosed content marker '+locale);
+  if(locale!=='en')check(!source.includes('No. Its ceiling is about 4.6 megapixels'),'Untranslated body '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: built page, native H1 (${h1}), canonical, three language alternates, hero and localized capture verified`);
+}
+for(const [locale,feed] of [['en','resources/rss.xml'],['fr','fr/ressources/rss.xml'],['zh','zh/resources/rss.xml']]){
+  const text=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,feed),'utf8');
+  const route=routes.find(x=>x[0]===locale)[1];
+  check(text.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Missing RSS entry '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: resource RSS entry verified`);
+}
+const index=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,'resources/how-to/index.html'),'utf8');
+check(index.indexOf('/resources/how-to/'+slug)>0,'Guide absent from index');
+const sitemaps=fs.readdirSync(base).filter(f=>/^sitemap.*\.xml$/.test(f)).map(f=>fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,f),'utf8')).join('\n');
+for(const [,route] of routes)check(sitemaps.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Sitemap missing '+route);
+console.log('How-to index and all three sitemap URLs verified.');

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

import { dirname, isAbsolute, relative as relativePath, sep } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { copyFilesToFolder } from "@astrojs/internal-helpers/fs";
import { appendForwardSlash } from "@astrojs/internal-helpers/path";
import { searchForWorkspaceRoot } from "./searchRoot.js";
function findCommonAncestor(rootPath, entryPath) {
  let ancestor = rootPath;
  let relativeEntryPath = relativePath(ancestor, entryPath);
  while (relativeEntryPath === ".." || relativeEntryPath.startsWith(`..${sep}`) || isAbsolute(relativeEntryPath)) {
    const parent = dirname(ancestor);
    if (parent === ancestor) break;
    ancestor = parent;
    relativeEntryPath = relativePath(ancestor, entryPath);
  }
  return ancestor;
}
async function copyDependenciesToFunction({
  entry,
  outDir,
  includeFiles,
  excludeFiles,
  logger,
  root
}, cache) {
  const entryPath = fileURLToPath(entry);
  logger.info(`Bundling function ${relativePath(fileURLToPath(outDir), entryPath)}`);
  const searchStart = findCommonAncestor(fileURLToPath(root), entryPath);
  const base = pathToFileURL(appendForwardSlash(searchForWorkspaceRoot(searchStart)));
  const { nodeFileTrace } = await import("@vercel/nft");
  const result = await nodeFileTrace([entryPath], {
    base: fileURLToPath(base),
    cache
  });
  for (const error of result.warnings) {
    if (error.message.startsWith("Failed to resolve dependency")) {
      const [, module, file] = /Cannot find module '(.+?)' loaded from (.+)/.exec(error.message);
      if (module === "@astrojs/") continue;
      if (module === "sharp") continue;
      if (entryPath === file) {
        logger.debug(
          `[@astrojs/vercel] The module "${module}" couldn't be resolved. This may not be a problem, but it's worth checking.`
        );
      } else {
        logger.debug(
          `[@astrojs/vercel] The module "${module}" inside the file "${file}" couldn't be resolved. This may not be a problem, but it's worth checking.`
        );
      }
    } else if (error.message.startsWith("Failed to parse")) {
      continue;
    } else {
      throw error;
    }
  }
  const commonAncestor = await copyFilesToFolder(
    [...result.fileList].map((file) => new URL(file, base)).concat(includeFiles),
    outDir,
    excludeFiles
  );
  return {
    // serverEntry location inside the outDir
    handler: relativePath(commonAncestor, entryPath)
  };
}
export {
  copyDependenciesToFunction,
  findCommonAncestor
};

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }

+    filled += count;
+  }
+}

+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');

+  const file=path.join(base,route,'index.html');
+  check(fs.existsSync(file),'Missing output '+file);
+  const source=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+  const html=parse(source);
+  const h1=html.querySelector('h1')?.textContent;
+  check(!!h1,'Missing heading '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.getAttribute('href')==='https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route,'Wrong canonical '+locale);
+  for(const lang of ['en','fr','zh-CN'])check(html.querySelector(`link[hreflang="${lang}"]`),'Missing alternate '+lang+' '+locale);
+  check(source.includes(`/Images/howto-${slug}.webp`),'Hero missing '+locale);

+  if(locale!=='en')check(!source.includes('No. Its ceiling is about 4.6 megapixels'),'Untranslated body '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: built page, native H1 (${h1}), canonical, three language alternates, hero and localized capture verified`);
+}

+  const text=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,feed),'utf8');
+  const route=routes.find(x=>x[0]===locale)[1];
+  check(text.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Missing RSS entry '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: resource RSS entry verified`);
+}
+const index=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,'resources/how-to/index.html'),'utf8');
+check(index.indexOf('/resources/how-to/'+slug)>0,'Guide absent from index');
+const sitemaps=fs.readdirSync(base).filter(f=>/^sitemap.*\.xml$/.test(f)).map(f=>fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,f),'utf8')).join('\n');

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const run=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',args,{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:32*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(run(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Primary index already contains changes');
+if(run(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==run(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Checkout heads differ');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-files.json'),'utf8'));
+for(const name of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs')).filter(n=>n.startsWith('2026-10-21-')))files.push('editorial/logs/runs/'+name);
+for(const file of files.filter(f=>f.startsWith('editorial/logs/')||f==='editorial/schedule.csv')){
+  const dest=path.join(release,file);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});
+  let content=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,file));
+  if(file.endsWith('.txt')&&!file.includes('.prompt.'))content=Buffer.from(content.toString('utf8').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(0x2014),' - '));
+  fs.writeFileSync(dest,content);
+}
+run(['add','--',...files,'src/i18n/routes.ts','src/i18n/dict'],release);
+run(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=run(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+run(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const a=run(['write-tree']).trim(),b=run(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(a!==b)throw Error('Staged release trees differ');
+console.log('Primary main index matches the validated release tree: '+a);
+console.log(run(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+if(run(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Primary index already contains changes');
+if(run(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==run(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Checkout heads differ');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-files.json'),'utf8'));
+for(const name of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs')).filter(n=>n.startsWith('2026-10-21-')))files.push('editorial/logs/runs/'+name);
+for(const file of files.filter(f=>f.startsWith('editorial/logs/')||f==='editorial/schedule.csv')){
+  const dest=path.join(release,file);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});
+  let content=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,file));
+  if(file.endsWith('.txt')&&!file.includes('.prompt.'))content=Buffer.from(content.toString('utf8').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(0x2014),' - '));
+  fs.writeFileSync(dest,content);
+}
+run(['add','--',...files,'src/i18n/routes.ts','src/i18n/dict'],release);
+run(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=run(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+run(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const a=run(['write-tree']).trim(),b=run(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(a!==b)throw Error('Staged release trees differ');
+console.log('Primary main index matches the validated release tree: '+a);
+console.log(run(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

diff --git a/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs b/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..24731addba8e8cbc25bb235e1c6616a5a1b1314e

+++ b/.i18n-work/fill-release-translations.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const before = 'which is 2,048 pixels square';
+const after = 'enough for a 2,048-pixel square';
+for (const base of [root, release]) {
+  for (const relative of ['editorial/output/seedream-5-pro-guide.md','src/pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.astro']) {
+    const file = path.join(base, relative);
+    const value = fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+    if (!value.includes(before)) throw new Error('Missing expected sentence in '+file);
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,value.replace(before,after));
+  }
+  for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+    const file = path.join(base,'src/i18n/dict',locale,'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json');
+    const dict = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const result = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(dict).map(([k,v])=>[k.replace(before,after),v]));
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');
+  }
+}
+fs.copyFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/research/seedream-5-pro-guide.md'),path.join(release,'editorial/research/seedream-5-pro-guide.md'));

+for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+  for (const id of ids) {
+    const source = path.join(__dirname,'passes',locale,id,'changes.md');
+    if (!fs.existsSync(source)) throw new Error('Missing pass summary '+source);
+    log += `\n### ${locale}: ${id}\n\n`+fs.readFileSync(source,'utf8')+'\n';
+  }
+}
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs/2026-10-21-publish.txt'),log);
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/2026-10-21.md'),log);
+console.log('Corrected the numerical relationship in draft/page and both dictionary keys; copied all 14 translation summaries into both run logs.');

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+  }
+}

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const run=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',args,{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:32*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(run(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Primary index already contains changes');
+if(run(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==run(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Checkout heads differ');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-files.json'),'utf8'));
+for(const name of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs')).filter(n=>n.startsWith('2026-10-21-')))files.push('editorial/logs/runs/'+name);
+for(const file of files.filter(f=>f.startsWith('editorial/logs/')||f==='editorial/schedule.csv')){
+  const dest=path.join(release,file);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});
+  let content=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,file));
+  if(file.endsWith('.txt')&&!file.includes('.prompt.'))content=Buffer.from(content.toString('utf8').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(0x2014),' - '));
+  fs.writeFileSync(dest,content);
+}
+run(['add','--',...files,'src/i18n/routes.ts','src/i18n/dict'],release);
+run(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=run(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+run(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const a=run(['write-tree']).trim(),b=run(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(a!==b)throw Error('Staged release trees differ');
+console.log('Primary main index matches the validated release tree: '+a);
+console.log(run(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const before = 'which is 2,048 pixels square';
+const after = 'enough for a 2,048-pixel square';
+for (const base of [root, release]) {
+  for (const relative of ['editorial/output/seedream-5-pro-guide.md','src/pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.astro']) {
+    const file = path.join(base, relative);
+    const value = fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+    if (!value.includes(before)) throw new Error('Missing expected sentence in '+file);
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,value.replace(before,after));
+  }
+  for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+    const file = path.join(base,'src/i18n/dict',locale,'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json');
+    const dict = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const result = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(dict).map(([k,v])=>[k.replace(before,after),v]));
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');
+  }
+}
+fs.copyFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/research/seedream-5-pro-guide.md'),path.join(release,'editorial/research/seedream-5-pro-guide.md'));
+const ids = ['common','resources/how-to','resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide','app/create','app/engines','resources/how-to/chatgpt-image-2-product-prompting-guide','resources/how-to/product-photo-to-lifestyle-image'];
+let log = '\n## Publication translation review: seedream-5-pro-guide\n\n';
+for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+  for (const id of ids) {
+    const source = path.join(__dirname,'passes',locale,id,'changes.md');
+    if (!fs.existsSync(source)) throw new Error('Missing pass summary '+source);
+    log += `\n### ${locale}: ${id}\n\n`+fs.readFileSync(source,'utf8')+'\n';
+  }
+}
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs/2026-10-21-publish.txt'),log);
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/2026-10-21.md'),log);
+console.log('Corrected the numerical relationship in draft/page and both dictionary keys; copied all 14 translation summaries into both run logs.');

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const run=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',args,{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:32*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(run(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Primary index already contains changes');
+if(run(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==run(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Checkout heads differ');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-files.json'),'utf8'));
+for(const name of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs')).filter(n=>n.startsWith('2026-10-21-')))files.push('editorial/logs/runs/'+name);
+for(const file of files.filter(f=>f.startsWith('editorial/logs/')||f==='editorial/schedule.csv')){
+  const dest=path.join(release,file);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});
+  let content=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,file));
+  if(file.endsWith('.txt')&&!file.includes('.prompt.'))content=Buffer.from(content.toString('utf8').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(0x2014),' - '));
+  fs.writeFileSync(dest,content);
+}
+run(['add','--',...files,'src/i18n/routes.ts','src/i18n/dict'],release);
+run(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=run(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+run(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const a=run(['write-tree']).trim(),b=run(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(a!==b)throw Error('Staged release trees differ');
+console.log('Primary main index matches the validated release tree: '+a);
+console.log(run(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const {parse} = require('node-html-parser');
+const base = path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-release','.vercel/output/static');
+const slug = 'seedream-5-pro-guide';
+const routes = [
+  ['en',`/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+  ['fr','/fr/ressources/guides-pratiques/seedream-5-pro-prompts-pour-images-produit'],
+  ['zh',`/zh/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+];
+const check = (condition,message) => {if (!condition) throw new Error(message);};
+for(const [locale,route] of routes){
+  const file=path.join(base,route,'index.html');
+  check(fs.existsSync(file),'Missing output '+file);
+  const source=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+  const html=parse(source);
+  const h1=html.querySelector('h1')?.textContent;
+  check(!!h1,'Missing heading '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.getAttribute('href')==='https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route,'Wrong canonical '+locale);
+  for(const lang of ['en','fr','zh-CN'])check(html.querySelector(`link[hreflang="${lang}"]`),'Missing alternate '+lang+' '+locale);
+  check(source.includes(`/Images/howto-${slug}.webp`),'Hero missing '+locale);
+  const shot='/Images/help/create-an-image-studio'+(locale==='en'?'':'.'+locale)+'.webp';
+  check(source.includes(shot),'Wrong capture '+locale);
+  check(!/\b(?:TODO|FIXME|TBD|TKTK)\b/.test(html.querySelector('main')?.textContent||''),'Unclosed content marker '+locale);
+  if(locale!=='en')check(!source.includes('No. Its ceiling is about 4.6 megapixels'),'Untranslated body '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: built page, native H1 (${h1}), canonical, three language alternates, hero and localized capture verified`);
+}
+for(const [locale,feed] of [['en','resources/rss.xml'],['fr','fr/ressources/rss.xml'],['zh','zh/resources/rss.xml']]){
+  const text=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,feed),'utf8');
+  const route=routes.find(x=>x[0]===locale)[1];
+  check(text.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Missing RSS entry '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: resource RSS entry verified`);
+}
+const index=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,'resources/how-to/index.html'),'utf8');
+check(index.indexOf('/resources/how-to/'+slug)>0,'Guide absent from index');
+const sitemaps=fs.readdirSync(base).filter(f=>/^sitemap.*\.xml$/.test(f)).map(f=>fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,f),'utf8')).join('\n');
+for(const [,route] of routes)check(sitemaps.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Sitemap missing '+route);
+console.log('How-to index and all three sitemap URLs verified.');

+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const before = 'which is 2,048 pixels square';
+const after = 'enough for a 2,048-pixel square';
+for (const base of [root, release]) {
+  for (const relative of ['editorial/output/seedream-5-pro-guide.md','src/pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.astro']) {
+    const file = path.join(base, relative);
+    const value = fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');

+    fs.writeFileSync(file,value.replace(before,after));

+  }
+}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const {parse} = require('node-html-parser');
+const base = path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-release','.vercel/output/static');
+const slug = 'seedream-5-pro-guide';
+const routes = [
+  ['en',`/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+  ['fr','/fr/ressources/guides-pratiques/seedream-5-pro-prompts-pour-images-produit'],
+  ['zh',`/zh/resources/how-to/${slug}`],
+];
+const check = (condition,message) => {if (!condition) throw new Error(message);};
+for(const [locale,route] of routes){
+  const file=path.join(base,route,'index.html');
+  check(fs.existsSync(file),'Missing output '+file);
+  const source=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+  const html=parse(source);
+  const h1=html.querySelector('h1')?.textContent;
+  check(!!h1,'Missing heading '+locale);
+  check(html.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.getAttribute('href')==='https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route,'Wrong canonical '+locale);
+  for(const lang of ['en','fr','zh-CN'])check(html.querySelector(`link[hreflang="${lang}"]`),'Missing alternate '+lang+' '+locale);
+  check(source.includes(`/Images/howto-${slug}.webp`),'Hero missing '+locale);

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const run=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',args,{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:32*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(run(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Primary index already contains changes');
+if(run(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==run(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Checkout heads differ');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-files.json'),'utf8'));
+for(const name of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs')).filter(n=>n.startsWith('2026-10-21-')))files.push('editorial/logs/runs/'+name);
+for(const file of files.filter(f=>f.startsWith('editorial/logs/')||f==='editorial/schedule.csv')){
+  const dest=path.join(release,file);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});
+  let content=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,file));
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/')&&!file.includes('.prompt.'))content=Buffer.from(content.toString('utf8').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(0x2014),' - ').replace(/\r\n?/g,'\n').replace(/[ \t]+$/gm,'').trimEnd()+'\n');
+  fs.writeFileSync(dest,content);
+}
+run(['add','--',...files,'src/i18n/routes.ts','src/i18n/dict'],release);
+run(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=run(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+run(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const a=run(['write-tree']).trim(),b=run(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(a!==b)throw Error('Staged release trees differ');
+console.log('Primary main index matches the validated release tree: '+a);
+console.log(run(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');
+const release=path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const run=(args,cwd=root,extra={})=>cp.execFileSync('git',args,{cwd,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'],maxBuffer:32*1024*1024,...extra});
+if(run(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).trim())throw Error('Primary index already contains changes');
+if(run(['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim()!==run(['rev-parse','HEAD'],release).trim())throw Error('Checkout heads differ');
+const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'publish-2026-10-21-files.json'),'utf8'));
+for(const name of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs')).filter(n=>n.startsWith('2026-10-21-')))files.push('editorial/logs/runs/'+name);
+for(const file of files.filter(f=>f.startsWith('editorial/logs/')||f==='editorial/schedule.csv')){
+  const dest=path.join(release,file);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});
+  let content=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,file));
+  if(file.startsWith('editorial/logs/')&&!file.includes('.prompt.'))content=Buffer.from(content.toString('utf8').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(0x2014),' - ').replace(/\r\n?/g,'\n').replace(/[ \t]+$/gm,'').trimEnd()+'\n');
+  fs.writeFileSync(dest,content);
+}
+run(['add','--',...files,'src/i18n/routes.ts','src/i18n/dict'],release);
+run(['diff','--cached','--check'],release);
+const patch=run(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+run(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const a=run(['write-tree']).trim(),b=run(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(a!==b)throw Error('Staged release trees differ');
+console.log('Primary main index matches the validated release tree: '+a);
+console.log(run(['diff','--cached','--stat']));

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+  fs.writeFileSync(dest,content);
+}
+run(['add','--',...files,'src/i18n/routes.ts','src/i18n/dict'],release);

+run(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const a=run(['write-tree']).trim(),b=run(['write-tree'],release).trim();
+if(a!==b)throw Error('Staged release trees differ');
+console.log('Primary main index matches the validated release tree: '+a);

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+  const route=routes.find(x=>x[0]===locale)[1];
+  check(text.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Missing RSS entry '+locale);
+  console.log(`${locale}: resource RSS entry verified`);
+}
+const index=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,'resources/how-to/index.html'),'utf8');
+check(index.indexOf('/resources/how-to/'+slug)>0,'Guide absent from index');

+for(const [,route] of routes)check(sitemaps.includes('https://www.hubstudio.ai'+route),'Sitemap missing '+route);
+console.log('How-to index and all three sitemap URLs verified.');

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..24731addba8e8cbc25bb235e1c6616a5a1b1314e

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const before = 'which is 2,048 pixels square';
+const after = 'enough for a 2,048-pixel square';
+for (const base of [root, release]) {
+  for (const relative of ['editorial/output/seedream-5-pro-guide.md','src/pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.astro']) {
+    const file = path.join(base, relative);
+    const value = fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
+    if (!value.includes(before)) throw new Error('Missing expected sentence in '+file);
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,value.replace(before,after));
+  }
+  for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+    const file = path.join(base,'src/i18n/dict',locale,'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json');
+    const dict = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const result = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(dict).map(([k,v])=>[k.replace(before,after),v]));
+    fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');
+  }
+}
+fs.copyFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/research/seedream-5-pro-guide.md'),path.join(release,'editorial/research/seedream-5-pro-guide.md'));
+const ids = ['common','resources/how-to','resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide','app/create','app/engines','resources/how-to/chatgpt-image-2-product-prompting-guide','resources/how-to/product-photo-to-lifestyle-image'];
+let log = '\n## Publication translation review: seedream-5-pro-guide\n\n';
+for (const locale of ['fr','zh']) {
+  for (const id of ids) {
+    const source = path.join(__dirname,'passes',locale,id,'changes.md');
+    if (!fs.existsSync(source)) throw new Error('Missing pass summary '+source);
+    log += `\n### ${locale}: ${id}\n\n`+fs.readFileSync(source,'utf8')+'\n';
+  }
+}
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/runs/2026-10-21-publish.txt'),log);
+fs.appendFileSync(path.join(root,'editorial/logs/2026-10-21.md'),log);
+console.log('Corrected the numerical relationship in draft/page and both dictionary keys; copied all 14 translation summaries into both run logs.');

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const release = path.join(__dirname, 'publish-2026-10-21-release');
+const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d,e.name)) : [path.join(d,e.name)]);
+let filled = 0;
+const missing = [];
+for (const locale of ['fr', 'zh']) {
+  const sourceRoot = path.join(root,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const targetRoot = path.join(release,'src/i18n/dict',locale);
+  const shared = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sourceRoot,'common.json'),'utf8'));
+  for (const file of walk(targetRoot).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json'))) {
+    const target = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
+    const sourceFile = path.join(sourceRoot,path.relative(targetRoot,file));
+    const source = fs.existsSync(sourceFile) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sourceFile,'utf8')) : {};
+    let count = 0;
+    for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(target)) {
+      if (value && path.relative(targetRoot,file).replaceAll('\\','/') !== 'pages/resources/how-to/seedream-5-pro-guide.json') continue;
+      const translated = source[key] || shared[key];
+      if (!translated) { missing.push(`${locale}/${path.relative(targetRoot,file)}: ${key.slice(0,80)}`); continue; }
+      target[key] = translated;
+      count++;
+    }
+    if (count) fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(target,null,2)+'\n');
+    filled += count;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`Copied ${filled} translated entries required by the isolated release.`);
+if (missing.length) {console.error(missing.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}

+}

+const patch=run(['diff','--cached','--binary','--full-index'],release,{encoding:'buffer'});
+run(['apply','--cached','--whitespace=nowarn','-'],root,{input:patch});
+const a=run(['write-tree']).trim(),b=run(['write-tree'],release).trim();
